fact: ECOWAS and Sierra Leone's Ministry of Information and Communications co-organised a national consultation in Freetown on 22-24 November 2022 on the draft regional digital economy framework, and the minister stated Sierra Leone had concluded domestication of all ECOWAS legal texts in the sector.
title: ECOWAS consults stakeholders in Sierra Leone on the draft new legal and regulatory framework to govern the digital economy in West Africa
publisher: Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)
